title: Prepare a CLI environment
responsibility: Builds a subprocess environment with the configured environment filtering and executable search paths.

outputs.name: cliEnvironment
outputs.description: An environment object copied from `scrubEnvironment()` for task subprocesses, with `PATH` rebuilt from its nonempty existing entries followed in order by the user's `.local/bin` and `.bun/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `/usr/bin`, and `/bin`; duplicates are removed by keeping their first occurrence. Finder-launched apps may inherit a minimal `PATH`, and this helper changes only the returned object.
